title: Privilege escalation due to uninitialized memory in the Graphics: CanvasWebGL component
description: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in the Graphics: CanvasWebGL component of Microsoft software version 4.0 due to uninitialized memory. This flaw could potentially allow an attacker to gain elevated privileges on the affected system. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided, and no public exploits or patches are currently known.
